name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
summary: At Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles, you join Kanati Greycloud as Galak assassins close in. Their orders name the tauren for death.

sections.title: An Ambush Revealed
sections.body: At Whitereach Post, Kanati Greycloud finds centaur orders naming him as a target. The Galak centaur have long fought the nomadic tauren and their Horde allies. Raiding supply paths is not enough for them. They also seek to kill those who settle in their canyons.

sections.title: Defending Whitereach Post
sections.body: Kanati suspects the Galak will strike soon, and their numbers may be greater than he first thought. So he asks travelers at the post to stand with him. When the assassins attack, Kanati holds his ground beside his allies. Their blades and spells can break the ambush before the centaur kill him.

faq.answer: Kanati Greycloud is a tauren with a hunting camp at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. The camp lies near canyons claimed by local centaur clans.

faq.q: Why are the centaur trying to assassinate him?
faq.answer: The Galak centaur see the tauren and their Horde encampments as enemies encroaching on their canyon territory. They aim to kill Kanati and drive out his hunting camp and anyone who might follow him.

faq.q: Where does this defense take place?
faq.answer: The ambush takes place at Whitereach Post, a small Horde outpost along the canyon paths of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Which centaur clan attacks Kanati Greycloud?
faq.answer: The assassins belong to the Galak tribe, a centaur clan that inhabits the canyons and ravines of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What happens after the assassins are defeated?
faq.answer: After the Galak assassins are slain, Kanati lives and Whitereach Post remains secure. He thanks those who stood with him during the surprise assault.

faq.q: Does Kanati Greycloud fight in the battle?
faq.answer: Yes. Kanati fights beside those who answer his plea, helping repel the assassins who came to kill him.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the feud with the centaur runs deep. Protecting a fellow tribesman from assassination is a matter of survival and honor.
As a member of the Horde, you know Whitereach Post offers a key vantage point in Thousand Needles. Keeping sentries like Kanati alive helps secure Horde operations throughout the canyon.
